_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: I will not leave you orphaned, he said.
He is coming to us still.
The Father will send another Advocate,
the Spirit of truth, to be with us always.
In him we live and move and have our being.
We are never beyond his keeping.
Christ is risen!
Christ is risen, alleluia!

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Come, all you who have felt left behind, who know what an empty house can feel like; hear the promise — I will not leave you orphaned.
Christ is risen, alleluia!
He is sending another Advocate, the Spirit of truth, to live not far off but near, with you and in you.
Christ is risen, alleluia!
For in God we live and move and have our being; there is no road that runs past the edge of his love.
Christ is risen, alleluia!
So come and bless our God, you peoples; he has kept us among the living and held our feet from slipping.
Christ is risen, alleluia!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: I will not leave you orphaned, says the Lord.
Christ is risen, alleluia!
He sends the Spirit of truth to be with us always.
Christ is risen, alleluia!
In him we live and move and have our being.
Christ is risen, alleluia!
Bless our God, you peoples. Come, let us worship.
Christ is risen, alleluia!
